510701.name: Missile Strike
510701.description: Fires missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

510704.name: Intense Laser
510704.description: Fires a laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

510705.name: Turret Assault
510705.description: Fires a barrage of bullets from a nearby turret, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The turret can be destroyed.

510709.name: Repair Turret
510709.description: Fires a barrage of bullets from a nearby turret, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The turret can be destroyed. Restores a portion of all enemies' HP when the turret is summoned.
